offering_description.value: Sponsors and manages exchange-traded products (ETPs) including equity, fixed income, commodity and crypto ETFs and ETNs. Sells to investors through financial advisers, brokers and institutions. Also offers digital asset tokenization and fund services, earning fees on assets under management.

primary_products.value: exchange-traded funds; exchange-traded notes; crypto and gold exchange-traded products; tokenized funds

primary_services.value: asset management; digital wallet and tokenized fund services; model portfolio management

customer_segment.value: B2B: financial advisers, broker-dealers, wealth managers, institutional investors; B2C: retail investors buying ETPs via brokerage accounts and WisdomTree digital app users

end_markets.value: asset management; wealth management; financial markets; digital assets

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: advisory fees on assets under management in ETPs; service fees: digital wallet and tokenization platform fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: ETP sponsor and asset manager, selling investment products to advisers and investors; software / platform: digital asset and tokenized fund platform

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Canada, Japan and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: ETPs across equities, fixed income, commodities, crypto plus tokenization and model portfolios

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: brokerage platforms and exchanges listing the ETPs; direct sales: sales teams to financial advisers and institutions; online: digital app for tokenized funds and wallet

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser and fund sponsor under SEC, Investment Company Act, FCA and European rules
